newsitem.title: UK: NWE high, low sulphur fuel oil ease with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE high, low sulphur fuel oil ease with crude.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil steadied on Friday after Thursday's fall and low sulphur was steady to softer under a continued weight of supply, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded in the morning at $103 and $104 fob ARA then moved up by around a dollar per tonne in the afternoon.

High sulphur cargoes were weaker with cif prices close to those seen in the barge market. A British utility was heard to have bought a high sulphur cargo, possibly from a trader, at around $105.50 cif NWE.
This follows a deal heard done into another utility late on Thursday at around the same level.

Low sulphur fuel oil was around a dollar per tonne weaker, but largely inactive in the absence of buying from Italy. Physical offers were pegged at $109.50 fob NWE or lower. Dealers said offers from across the Atlantic were notionally at least a couple of dollars above NWE prices, making arbitrage trade unworkable.
